section.content: 本发明提供与功率开关的温度无关，能够确保定的软切断时间的半导体集成电路。控制IC(半导体集成电路)(10)具备：控制电路(17)；检测流向IGBT(2)的电流的感应电阻Rsns；以及驱动IGBT(2)的驱动电路(13)。控制电路(17)输入对IGBT(2)进行导通/截止控制的控制信号Sin，在控制信号Sin超过规定时间后继续IGBT(2)的导通控制时，输出值从规定值渐减的基准电压Vref。驱动电路(13)根据控制信号Sin进行IGBT(2)的导通/截止控制，并且根据基准电压Vref和与感应电阻Rsns检测的电流相当的感应电压Vsns，输出限制流向IGBT(2)的电流的栅极电压Vg。

The present invention provides unrelated with the temperature of power switch, it can be ensured that the semiconductor integrated circuit of certain soft kill time.Control IC (semiconductor integrated circuit) (10) possesses：Control circuit (17)；Detection flows to the inductive reactance Rsns of IGBT (2) electric current；And driving IGBT (2) drive circuit (13).Control circuit (17) input carries out the control signal Sin of conduction and cut-off control to IGBT (2), when continuing IGBT (2) conducting control after control signal Sin exceeds schedule time, reference voltage V ref of the output valve from setting decrescence.The conduction and cut-off that drive circuit (13) carries out IGBT (2) according to control signal Sin controls, and according to reference voltage V ref and the induced voltage Vsns suitable with the electric current that inductive reactance Rsns is detected, export-restriction flows to the grid voltage Vg of IGBT (2) electric current.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to semiconductor integrated circuit, more particularly in the igniter of internal combustion engine for vehicle, possess and be directed to The application of prolonged power on signal and the semiconductor integrated circuit of the defencive function of the power switch of soft kill semiconductor.

Background technology

The igniter of internal combustion engine for vehicle possesses：Electric spark occurs and lights the spark of the gaseous mixture of fuel and air Plug；The high-tension ignition coil applied to the spark plug occurs；And drive the igniter of the ignition coil.Ignitor It is standby：The power switch of drive ignition coil；Opened with power is carried out according to the control signal from engine control system (ECU) The conduction and cut-off control of pass and the control IC (integrated circuit) of the function of protection power switch.Work(as protection power switch One of can, control IC possesses when to more than power switch certain time applying Continuity signal, and power switch is cut Only control, force disconnect flows to the defencive function of the electric current of power switch.

The defencive function for cutting off the power switch is the standby defencive function of ignitor, and from engine control system Cutoff action performed by control signal independently acts.Thus, sometimes with the time of ignition of engine control system not With at the time of rupturing duty switch.If the exception of ignition timing as producing, engine cause this kind of different of tempering, pinking Often burning.

Therefore, when rupturing duty switchs, the degree of electric spark will not occur with spark plug, carry out slowly cut-out and flow to work( The failure of current action of the electric current of rate switch, i.e., so-called soft kill (for example, referring to patent document 1).

In the patent document 1, soft kill is by will control output section the resistance key element and composition that have of power switch The variable resistor of resistor voltage divider circuit is connected to the gate terminal of power switch and realized together.When carrying out soft kill, cut Change, the resistance value of variable resistor is periodically diminished.So as to which the voltage of the gate terminal of power switch slowly reduces, flow direction The electric current of power switch is slowly cut off.Now, spark plug will not light a fire.

The content of the invention

The technical problems to be solved by the invention

But the current confinement part of overcurrent protection of the circuit of the soft kill in patent document 1 with carrying out power switch It is independent on circuit, therefore the problem of causing the soft kill time that deviation occurs because of the temperature characterisitic of power switch be present.

The present invention in view of so the problem of and propose, it is therefore an objective to provide：And power switch temperature (comprising individual deviation, Temperature change) it is unrelated, it can be ensured that the semiconductor integrated circuit of certain soft kill time.

Solves the technical scheme of technical problem

It is above-mentioned in order to solve the problems, such as, there is provided semiconductor integrated circuit in the present invention.The semiconductor integrated circuit, possesses： Input to power switch carry out conduction and cut-off control control signal, after the control signal exceeds schedule time still after It is continuous when conducting control is carried out to the power switch, the soft kill circuit of reference voltage of the output valve from setting decrescence；Detection Flow to the current detection circuit of the electric current of the power switch；And the power switch is led according to the control signal Logical/cut-off control, and according to the reference voltage and the induced electricity suitable with the electric current that the current detection circuit detects Pressure, export-restriction flow to the drive circuit of the drive signal of the electric current of the power switch.

The effect of invention

The semiconductor integrated circuit of said structure monitors the electric current of power switch while carrying out soft kill, therefore, tool The advantages of deviation having even for the threshold temperature characteristic of power switch can also ensure that certain soft kill time.

The igniter of internal combustion engine for vehicle possesses igniter 1, and the igniter 1 has control IC10 and as power switch IGBT (Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor：Igbt) 2.In addition, used here as IGBT2 can also use MOSFET (Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor Field-Effect as power switch Transistor：Mos field effect transistor) such other power switch.

The grid voltage Vg of IC10 outputs is controlled to apply to IGBT2 gate terminal.IGBT2 has the shape in same chip Into electric current induction region and electric current sensing terminal.The electric current senses terminal forms IGBT2 with controlling current detecting in IC10 The inductive reactance Rsns of circuit terminal connection, inductive reactance Rsns another terminal ground.In IGBT2 electric current sense Terminal is answered, the electric current corresponding with the area ratio of main emitter region and electric current sense emitter region is via inductive reactance Rsns Flow direction ground, so as to the induced voltage Vsns for inducting proportional to emitter current at inductive reactance Rsns both ends.The induced electricity Pressure Vsns feeds back to control IC10 drive circuit 13, and IGBT2 electric current is flowed to for limiting.

IGBT2 emitter terminal ground connection, an end of IGBT2 collector terminal and the primary winding of ignition coil 3 Son connection.One terminal of the secondary coil of ignition coil 3 is connected with a terminal of spark plug 4, another end of spark plug 4 Son ground connection.The primary winding of ignition coil 3 and another terminal of secondary coil are connected with the anode electrode of battery 5, battery 5 Negative electrode is grounded.

According to the igniter of above structure, if inputting the control signal Sin of high (H) level from engine control system, Then drive circuit 13 carries out conducting control to IGBT2.So as to the primary winding from the electric current that battery 5 supplies via ignition coil 3 And IGBT2 flow directions ground, magnetic field is produced in primary winding, by magnetic core, magnetic field also occurs in secondary coil.Now, drive circuit 13 detect the electric current for flowing through IGBT2 indirectly, and playing makes not having the current limit function that overcurrent flows through in IGBT2.

Then, if carrying out cut-off control to IGBT2 at the time of regulation, electricity is occurred in primary winding by self inductance effect Pressure, high voltage is occurred in secondary coil by mutual inductance.The high voltage is fed into spark plug 4, occurs between the gap of spark plug 4 Spark.

Here, if the grid voltage of the conducting control applied to IGBT2 gate terminal is with longer than common ON time Time continue, then control IC10 control circuit 17 work, to drive circuit 13 supply reference voltage V ref decrescence.This When, drive circuit 13, makes in ignition coil by reference voltage V ref decrescence on the basis of above-mentioned current limit function The voltage that 3 secondary coil occurs will not become the high voltage of scintillant voltage between gap than making spark plug 4.From And the igniter will not at the unwanted moment between the gap of spark plug 4 flashing, the electric current for flowing through IGBT2 is existed Untill zero being reduced to during the soft kill time.

During the soft kill time, drive circuit 13 monitors IGBT2 electric current while carrying out soft kill, because This, the advantages of deviation of threshold temperature characteristic having even for IGBT2 can also ensure that certain soft kill time.
